title: Humanscale Nova LED Task Light
body_html:
Award-winning task light, engineered down to the last lumen.

Humanscale’s Nova combines advanced LED Light Guide technology with a 91+ CRI optical lens to cast a uniform, glare-free footprint that renders work vivid and clear. One-touch dimming and an occupancy sensor make it effortless to use and easy on energy — just 7 watts at full output.

Key features

  • 91+ CRI, glare-free neutral light
  • Touch dimming, 14–100%, with occupancy sensor
  • 440 lumens at just 7 watts
  • ENERGY STAR 2.0 certified, Red List–free
  • One-hand adjustability on a desktop base

Who it’s for

Private offices, workstations, and video-call setups that need precise, glare-free task lighting.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
